summary: Family communication app with AI-powered question paper analysis, sentiment-based happiness meter, problem-solving tracking, family guidance with professional tone, permission management for children, fight/conflict resolution tracking, and weekly expense tracking with AI-powered analysis and recommendations
architectural_notes: App requires real-time updates for location sharing and messaging
Consider family-based user groups/circles for privacy
Dashboard should aggregate multiple content types (status, photos, reminders)
AI integration required for text analysis and educational content processing
Sentiment analysis needed for happiness meter feature
Professional tone enforcement layer for AI responses

User role system required (parent vs child) set at login or registration
Permission request workflow: child submits → parent reviews → approve/deny
AI must analyze chat messages to detect conflict patterns and resolution indicators
